Description: Choosing or activating a specific object or option in the environment or interface using a pointing or contact input.
Moving the user or viewpoint through virtual space including locomotion and perspective changes.
Physically interacting with or transforming an object in the environment such as grabbing and moving objects.
Operating a continuous input device such as a joystick or lever to control a vehicle or system parameter.
Directing a virtual projectile or tool toward a target through controller orientation or movement.
Creating a freehand visual stroke or shape in virtual space using motion-tracked input.
Scrolling or sliding through a list or panel using a directional gesture or thumbstick input.
